statement.notes: Extracted from the Consolidated Income Statement on page 471. Revenue mapped from 'Sales revenue'. Total operating cost includes all operating line items before the operating result: Cost of sales, Distribution expenses, Administrative expenses, Other operating income (added as a positive component), and Other operating expenses. Net income mapped from 'Earnings after tax'. Taxes mapped from 'Income tax income/expense' (positive number representing expense). Interest expenses taken directly from the line item. All values are in € million as per the statement. Prior-year figures for 2023 are adjusted per the note.
